prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a low-speed head-on collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1295; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm has been retained to represent the interests of our client in connection with a motor vehicle collision involving your insured. Please direct all further communications regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly. Any statements, requests for information, or settlement discussions should come through this firm.

We ask that you provide the bodily injury and property damage liability limits of the policy covering your insured, along with a certified copy of the declarations page, within fourteen days of receipt of this letter.

Our client was injured in a head-on collision that occurred at low speed, and we are documenting the medical treatment and losses that have resulted. Please take immediate steps to preserve all evidence relating to the incident, including photographs, vehicle data and event data recorder information, dashcam or surveillance footage, claim file notes, recorded statements, and repair or total loss appraisals. Failure to preserve such evidence may result in sanctions in any later proceeding.

We look forward to your prompt written confirmation that this letter has been received and that the requested evidence is being preserved.
